followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are near-tied on capability across all relevant evals (Creative Generation 85.9 vs 84.7, within variance), so quality wasn't the deciding factor. I leaned on self-reported task preferences as a tiebreaker. The query is friendly/warm in tone and highly generative (open-ended course design, inventing subtopics and skill breakdowns)—exactly the dimensions where Dunlin reports a strong positive preference. Plover's distinguishing trait is desensitization to distasteful/hostile content, which is irrelevant for this benign request. So Dunlin was the marginally better fit.
